title: Compose and publish Remix Protocol: Halftime Stomp variation
description: Compose and publish a heavy 104 BPM halftime Big Beat variation of Remix Protocol using moving chords (i - VI - VII - i) and massive beat 3 snare space.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and auditioned Remix Protocol: Halftime Stomp variation (104 BPM, Am) with moving chord progression (Am -> F -> G -> Am). Uses heavy beat-3 halftime snare, wide kick spaces, and stepped sub chord tones. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Remix Protocol: Halftime Stomp_apr.

right_now_summary: The halftime Remix Protocol variation was composed, auditioned, and published to cloud storage.
